functions.name: grantOptionalPermissions
functions.description: Grant every missing optional permission from the manifest. Returns the permissions that were missing.

functions.name: quit
functions.description: Ask Thunderbird to exit cleanly, the way closing its last window would. Returns before it has.

functions.name: checkMail
functions.description: Fetch new mail now for one account, or all accounts when omitted. Returns the account ids checked.

functions.name: provisionAccount
functions.description: Create a password-authenticated IMAP+SMTP account. Idempotent on (imap.username, imap.host).

functions.name: glodaConversations
functions.description: Which conversation Thunderbird has put each headerMessageId in. Threading is Gloda's, not ours.

functions.name: glodaSearch
functions.description: Gloda's ranked full-text search across every indexed folder. Returns MessageHeaders.

functions.name: filtersList
functions.description: The account's own message filters, from msgFilterRules.dat.

functions.name: filtersCreate
functions.description: Adds a filter that moves matching mail to a folder, and saves the list.

functions.name: devEval
functions.description: Run privileged code in the parent process. Disabled unless pref extensions.noctmalia.dev is true.
